mapper.sql: cc.id AS id, cc.name AS name, cc.photo AS photo, cc.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, cc.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM crm_categories AS cc LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = cc.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = cc.modified_by

WHERE cc.is_active = 1
AND ( cc.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR cc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_categories ( name, photo, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{category.name}, #{category.photo}, NOW(), #{category.createdBy}, #{category.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_categories SET name = #{category.name}, photo = #{category.photo}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{category.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{category.id} AND is_active = 1
